modules.name: ScrollFlow
modules.tagline: A little momentum goes a long way.
modules.description: Bring touchpad-style movement to a regular wheel with the Glide scrolling engine.
features: Per-app speed, inversion and glide duration
modules.limit: Run ScrollFlow instead of standalone Glide. Native gestures require OS support; some applications coalesce fallback wheel packets.

modules.name: CursorBlur
modules.description: The original CursorBlur executable, bundled with Nexus and managed with a single toggle.
features: Starts and stops with its module
Stops even if the Nexus host crashes
modules.limit: Uses its own defaults and timing; WPF FPS and reduced-motion controls do not change it. Disable it to stop motion. Requires the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 runtime; missing dependencies show Runtime help.

modules.name: Cursor Aura
modules.description: Add glow, a soft halo, trails, particles or a spotlight around your pointer.
modules.limit: The soft halo is a visual glow. For a trail of the actual cursor image, use CursorBlur. Click animation lives in ClickFX.

modules.name: ClickFX
modules.description: Ripples, rings and shockwaves for presentations, recordings or a more tactile desktop.
features: Distinct left and right click colors
modules.limit: Right-click color is fixed cyan in this preview. Custom audio files and independent animation timelines are not included.

modules.name: Cursor Lens
modules.description: A mouse-following magnifier for fine print, details and presentations.
features: Reusable capture buffers at the shared frame target
modules.limit: Protected video and secure desktop cannot be captured. HDR and mixed-DPI configurations need broader validation.

modules.name: Float
modules.tagline: Useful details. A small footprint on screen.
modules.description: Keep a live clock, CPU, memory and media controls in a compact floating widget.
modules.limit: Weather is fetched on enable. Now-playing titles, a widget designer and periodic weather refresh are not included.

modules.name: WindowGlide
modules.tagline: Put your windows where they belong.
modules.description: Snap into useful layouts with shortcuts, eased movement and magnetic screen edges.
modules.limit: Targets normal captioned windows. Elevated or protected applications can reject changes; a visual layout designer is still planned.

modules.name: ClipVault
modules.tagline: Find the text you just copied.
modules.description: Search, pin and reuse a bounded text and rich-text clipboard history.
features: Delete an entry or clear the history
modules.limit: History and pins are erased when the module stops or Nexus exits. No password-manager exclusion enforcement, image history or persistent vault is claimed.

modules.name: FocusFade
modules.tagline: Let your current window stand out.
modules.description: Dim the desktop around the active window and give its edges a subtle highlight.
modules.limit: This preview dims surroundings; it does not automatically hide windows or provide app exclusions and animated focus transitions.

modules.name: ScreenRuler
modules.description: Measure pixels, read coordinates and pick screen colors without opening a full design tool.
features: Copy a pixel color as a hex value
modules.limit: Ruler labels are monitor-local. Capture colors are SDR values, and unusual scaling or rotated displays need testing.

modules.name: KeyCast
modules.tagline: Show the shortcut, keep the explanation simple.
modules.description: An ephemeral keyboard and mouse overlay for tutorials and recordings.
features: No keystroke log written to disk
modules.limit: All-keys mode can expose passwords on screen. There is no automatic password-field detection; pause it before sensitive typing.

modules.name: Glassify
modules.description: Adjust opacity and topmost behavior for active or selected applications.
features: Original state restored on normal stop
modules.limit: Effects are best effort. No arbitrary third-party blur is included. Forced termination can prevent restoration; topmost behavior requires manual validation on some systems.

modules.name: QuickDock
modules.tagline: Your everyday controls, one shortcut away.
modules.description: A floating dock for media, volume and the Windows controls you reach for most.
features: Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, accessibility and power settings
modules.limit: Device buttons open native Windows settings. Nexus does not claim embedded Wi-Fi scans, Bluetooth switches or a universal hardware brightness slider.

cursor.name: Cursor & mouse
cursor.description: Five ways to make movement, clicks and small details feel better.

desktop.name: Your desktop
desktop.description: Four tools for windows, focus, useful information and the text you just copied.

productivity.name: Everyday tools
productivity.description: Four quiet helpers for measuring, presenting and controlling your workspace.
